answer_2.quote: ...To evaluate the performance of the generation, we adopt ROUGE and BLEU as the metrics. We keep the results of ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L. BLEU-1 and BLEU-N (an average of BLEU-1, BLEU-2, BLEU-3, and BLEU-4)...

answer_4.quote: ...We conduct a human evaluation to better analyze the quality of the generated rationales. First, we randomly sample 500 test cases... we present generated rationales ... to 5 human annotators with legal backgrounds... (1) Consistency level... (2) Fluency level. For each perspective, 1 denotes the lowest score while 5 denotes the best score...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to score the generated rationales on two criteria—consistency with the predicted judgment and fluency of the text—using a 1‑5 Likert scale.
